mode.description: Operation mode for the diffusion plugin. `'diffusion'` (default) builds a full SD / SDXL / SD3 / FLUX pipeline from the primary model plus optional auxiliary text encoders, VAE, unconditional diffusion model, and ESRGAN upscaler, and exposes diffusion({ ... }). `'upscale'` builds a standalone ESRGAN upscaler from the primary model file alone (auxiliary model sources are ignored) and exposes upscale({ ... }). `'video'` builds a `VideoStableDiffusion` pipeline and exposes video({ ... }). The video layout is selected from the auxiliary sources: supplying `embeddingsConnectorsModelSrc` loads the LTX-2 layout (Gemma text encoder via `llmModelSrc` + video VAE + connectors, optional `audioVaeModelSrc` for synchronized audio); otherwise the Wan layout is used (UMT5 text encoder via `t5XxlModelSrc` + VAE). On React Native, loading the video model on-device will likely fail because the video diffusion models currently shipped by QVAC are too large to load on typical mobile devices. `'world'` builds an ABot-World interactive world session and exposes worldCreateScene({ ... }) and worldStep({ ... }). It requires `taehvModelSrc`, plus `t5XxlModelSrc` + `vaeModelSrc` to create scenes and/or `sceneSrc` to walk a pre-built one. World sessions run only on the machine hosting the worker and need a dedicated GPU with at least 20 GB free VRAM.

If an explicit request cannot be satisfied (e.g. "integrated" with no integrated GPU, "dedicated" with no discrete GPU, or an out-of-range index) the addon falls back to CPU rather than substituting a different GPU. kvCache.description: Per-layer history KV cache (~3.7x fewer frame-passes per block). Costs ~1.2 GB more VRAM but keeps block times flat; without it they ramp from ~1.8 s to ~7.5 s as the recompute window fills.

modelId.description: The identifier of the loaded video model to use for generation. On React Native, the video diffusion models currently shipped by QVAC are too large to load on typical mobile devices.

requestId.description: Stable identifier for this in-flight video generation. Optional — falls back to a generated id when the field is missing.

prompt.description: Positive prompt describing the video to generate.

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt describing what to avoid.

lora.description: LTX video only. Worker-local absolute path to a LoRA adapter.

lora_strength.description: LTX video only. Runtime LoRA multiplier in [0, 10]; requires lora.

stg_scale.description: LTX video only. Spatiotemporal guidance scale in [0, 10].

stg_block.description: LTX video only. Transformer block skipped for spatiotemporal guidance.

width.description: Video width in pixels (must be a multiple of 16). LTX-2 and Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B additionally require a multiple of 32. LTX-2 is validated against the loaded model before generation; the TI2V requirement is enforced natively, derived from the loaded GGUF rather than its filename.

height.description: Video height in pixels (must be a multiple of 16). LTX-2 and Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B additionally require a multiple of 32. LTX-2 is validated against the loaded model before generation; the TI2V requirement is enforced natively, derived from the loaded GGUF rather than its filename.

video_frames.description: Frame count for the generated video; must satisfy (4*k + 1), where k>=1. LTX-2 additionally requires the stricter (8*k + 1) with a max of 257, validated against the loaded model before generation.

fps.description: AVI framerate metadata in frames per second; must be in (0, 120].

seed.description: Random seed; when omitted we pick one and return it in stats.

steps.description: Low-noise or single-expert denoising step count.

sampling_method.description: Sampling algorithm used by the low-noise diffusion scheduler.
sampling_method.title: VideoStreamRequestSamplingMethod

scheduler.description: Noise schedule to apply for the low-noise diffusion path.
scheduler.title: VideoStreamRequestScheduler

high_noise_steps.description: Wan 2.2 A14B high-noise expert step count. Requires a model loaded with modelConfig.highNoiseDiffusionModelSrc; rejected otherwise. Omit to let native routing derive the split from moe_boundary.

high_noise_sampler.description: Wan 2.2 A14B high-noise expert sampler. Requires a model loaded with modelConfig.highNoiseDiffusionModelSrc; rejected otherwise.
high_noise_sampler.title: VideoStreamRequestHighNoiseSampler

high_noise_scheduler.description: Wan 2.2 A14B high-noise expert scheduler. Requires a model loaded with modelConfig.highNoiseDiffusionModelSrc; rejected otherwise.
high_noise_scheduler.title: VideoStreamRequestHighNoiseScheduler

high_noise_cfg_scale.description: Wan 2.2 A14B high-noise expert CFG scale. Requires a model loaded with modelConfig.highNoiseDiffusionModelSrc; rejected otherwise.

high_noise_flow_shift.description: Wan 2.2 A14B high-noise expert flow shift override. Requires a model loaded with modelConfig.highNoiseDiffusionModelSrc; rejected otherwise.

moe_boundary.description: Wan 2.2 A14B mixture-of-experts boundary in [0, 1]. Requires a model loaded with modelConfig.highNoiseDiffusionModelSrc; rejected otherwise.

control_frames.description: Optional array of base64-encoded control-frame images.

vae_tiling.description: Enable VAE tiling for large videos on constrained VRAM.

temporal_tiling.description: LTX-2 only: tile the video VAE decode along the time axis to cap peak VRAM for HD / long clips. No effect on Wan (spatial-only VAE).

cache_preset.description: Optional name of a cached sampler preset to reuse.

mode.description: Generation mode: 'txt2vid' (no source frame) or 'img2vid' (first-frame image).
mode.title: VideoStreamRequestMode

init_image.description: Base64-encoded first-frame image (PNG/JPEG). Required for img2vid; rejected for txt2vid.

strength.description: img2vid denoise strength in [0, 1]; rejected for txt2vid.

reference_images.description: LTX txt2vid only. Exactly one base64-encoded composite reference sheet; requires lora.

reference_attention_strength.description: LTX txt2vid only. Reference denoise-mask strength in [0, 1]; requires reference_images.

reference_downscale_factor.description: LTX txt2vid only. Reference-image spatial factor; currently exactly 1.

modelLoadMs.description: Time in milliseconds spent loading the diffusion model.

generationMs.description: Wall-clock time in milliseconds spent generating the output.

conditionerMs.description: Time in milliseconds spent conditioning the prompt before denoising.

denoiseMs.description: Time in milliseconds spent in the diffusion denoising loop.

vaeMs.description: Time in milliseconds spent decoding diffusion latents with the VAE.

postProcessMs.description: Time in milliseconds spent encoding, upscaling, muxing, and emitting outputs.

stepsPerSecond.description: Diffusion denoising throughput in sampling steps per second.

totalGenerationMs.description: Total generation time in milliseconds across all images in the batch.

totalWallMs.description: Total wall-clock time in milliseconds including model load and sampling.

totalSteps.description: Total number of diffusion sampling steps executed.

totalGenerations.description: Total number of generation passes executed.

totalPixels.description: Total number of pixels generated across all images.

width.description: Width in pixels of each generated image.

height.description: Height in pixels of each generated image.

seed.description: Seed that produced these outputs (randomized when not supplied by the caller).

totalVideoFrames.description: Total number of video frames produced.

videoFrames.description: Frame count of the most recent generated video.

fps.description: Frames-per-second metadata for the most recent generated video.

hasAudio.description: True when the output AVI includes a muxed audio track (LTX-2 loaded with audioVaeModelSrc), false otherwise.

audioSampleRate.description: Sample rate (Hz) of the muxed audio track; 0 when there is no audio.

modelId.description: Identifier of a model loaded with modelConfig.mode: 'world'.

requestId.description: Stable identifier for this scene creation. Note that scene creation cannot be interrupted — the engine exposes no abort hook — so cancelling it stops the SDK from yielding, but the encode runs to completion.

prompt.description: Scene prompt, encoded verbatim by umT5-XXL. The reference pipeline prefixes prompts with "| unknown | ".

image.description: Base64 PNG/JPEG bytes of the first frame, up to 3 MB decoded and 8192x8192 pixels. It is cover-scaled and center-cropped to width x height, so a frame larger than the target resolution buys nothing. The pixel ceiling is read from the image header and enforced by the worker before anything decodes it, so a compressed image that expands to gigabytes is refused rather than allocated.

width.description: Scene width in pixels, a multiple of 32, at most 4096. Defaults to 832. width x height must also stay within 2088960 pixels (1920x1088). That product rule is a cross-field constraint, so it is NOT expressed in the generated JSON Schema or Python client — those validate each axis only, and the combined limit is enforced by the worker, which rejects the request before any GPU memory is allocated.

height.description: Scene height in pixels, a multiple of 32, at most 4096. Defaults to 480. See `width` for the total-pixel ceiling, which bounds the product as well as each axis and is enforced server-side.

returnPack.description: Return the generated scene pack in the response. Off by default: the pack is 10+ MB (a third larger again as base64) and the common create-then-walk-now flow never touches the bytes — the world is already live on the session. Turn it on to persist a world, then pass the saved file back as modelConfig.sceneSrc on a later load to walk it again.

data.description: Base64 of the finished scene pack (~10 MB). Persist it and pass it back as modelConfig.sceneSrc to walk the same world again later.

sceneCreateMs.description: Wall-clock time in milliseconds for the scene pack: loading the prompt and image encoders, encoding both, and writing the pack.

width.description: Scene width in pixels, baked into the pack.

height.description: Scene height in pixels, baked into the pack.

modelId.description: Identifier of a model loaded with modelConfig.mode: 'world'. The session activates on the first step when no sceneSrc was supplied at load.

requestId.description: Stable identifier for this in-flight block, for cancel(). Optional on the wire — the server generates one when the field is missing.

keys.description: Keys held for this block. WASD move, IJKL steer the camera; duplicates are collapsed. Omit or pass an empty array to idle.

step.description: The engine's own `step` counter, forwarded verbatim: blocks completed on this session. One tick is emitted per block, after its frames, so this is not progress within a block.

totalSteps.description: Frames DELIVERED by the block that just finished — a final count, not a running one, because the engine emits this after the frames rather than during. Named `totalSteps` only so the wire shape matches videoStream and diffusionStream, where that slot holds a sampler-step total.

elapsedMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed within this block so far.

data.description: Base64 of one decoded frame — PNG, or JPEG when world.frameJpegQuality is 1..100.

frameIndex.description: Zero-based index of this frame within the block.

modelLoadMs.description: Time in milliseconds spent loading the DiT, decoder and scene pack.

stepMs.description: Generation time in milliseconds for this block, excluding frame encoding.

totalStepMs.description: Cumulative generation time in milliseconds across the session.

totalSteps.description: Number of blocks generated so far in this session; resets when the session reloads.

totalFrames.description: Cumulative frames delivered across the session.

frames.description: Frames delivered for this block — 9 for the first block after a load (decoder warmup), 12 thereafter at the default numFramePerBlock.

actionMask.description: The 8-bit key mask this block was generated under (bit 0..7 = W,A,S,D,I,J,K,L).
